targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    mp.timestamp AS "time",
    mp.value AS value,
    md.metric_name AS metric
FROM metric_points mp
JOIN metric_definitions md
    ON md.id = mp.metric_definition_id
WHERE
    md.metric_name = 'CPUUtilization'
    AND md.resource_id = ${ec2_resource_id:sqlstring}
    AND md.region = ${region:sqlstring}
    AND $__timeFilter(mp.timestamp)
ORDER BY mp.timestamp;

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT region AS __text, region AS __value FROM metric_definitions WHERE enabled = TRUE ORDER BY region;
